claims.finding: The same 13D filer (CIK 0001734916) amended its Schedule 13D on 2026-08-11 at 21:21:42Z, six weeks after amending it on 2026-06-30 - an accelerating campaign cadence three weeks before the print - and not one item anywhere in the 103-item capture mentions it, the news and social flow going completely silent between 2026-08-10 and 2026-08-31 while the stock drifted down 10.08% over twenty sessions.

claims.why_not_priced: A $19 microcap with 447k average daily volume and one covering broker gets no aggregation of its ownership filings. The corpus proves the non-coverage rather than assuming it: 100 of the 103 captured items are EDGAR index rows, there is no news document at all, and the retail message stream has no post between 2026-08-10 and 2026-08-31 - i.e. nothing was said about the amendment on or after the day it was filed. If it had been priced, a name that moves a median 14.86% on prints would not have drifted quietly lower on no volume event. I sign it positive because an escalating amendment cadence at a company that has filed five separate item 5.02 8-Ks since January and whose own 10-K newly lists 'activist-driven strategic shifts' as a risk factor reads as a live campaign rather than an exit, and an exiting 5% holder typically files one final amendment and stops.
claims.independence: Two other parts of the corpus point the same way from different sources: the 10-K risk-factor diff summary at https://d-risk.ai/DAKT/10-K/2026-06-24 (docs/96e7b96f48554762ad1eebfa15bffabc5f18257e.txt, message of 2026-06-25) records 'leadership transition risk, and activist-driven strategic shifts' as newly added risk factors, and filings.json independently shows item 5.02 8-Ks on 2026-01-21, 2026-02-02, 2026-02-20, 2026-05-21 and 2026-07-17.
